objective: Measure an exact constant-divisor block203 decoder that removes repeated 128-bit division helpers from the direct Qwen3.8-27B row-scale4 GEMV

candidate.numeric_contract: bit-exact ternary decode, Q8 integer dots, and FP32 multiplication of stored FP16 row-scale4 factors
candidate.division_identity: for B=2^64 and small d, B=floor(B/d)*d+(B mod d); propagate each high-limb remainder with only constant 64-bit quotient/remainder operations
candidate.chunking: 25 radix-243 chunks followed by one radix-27 tail for exactly 128 trits
candidate.four_row_vectorization: decode four independent packed rows and use AVX2 maddubs against one shared activation vector

controls.generic_direct: the separately named direct decoder using repeated unsigned-128 divmod by a runtime small divisor in the same native build
controls.aligned_two_bit: the aligned two-bit row-scale4 AVX2 kernel with identical factors and arithmetic contract
controls.freeze_boundary: the authoritative generic-direct v1 result had not been observed when this gate and its thresholds were frozen

static_compiler_evidence.generic_direct_observation: the generic direct region contains repeated __udivti3 calls
static_compiler_evidence.constdiv_observation: the constdiv AVX2 inner region and scalar dot helper contain no __udivti3 calls and no integer divide instructions
static_compiler_evidence.interpretation: assembly structure motivates an empirical gate but is not a throughput result

measurement.cpu_affinity: one frozen physical core supplied by the watcher

promotion_rules: run only after the full 666-tensor row-scale reconstruction and storage gate and the generic direct-kernel watcher are terminal
